        <textCard>
          <text_title>Introduction to LCCDEs</text_title>
          <text_text>LCCDE form: \(a_n y^{(n)} + \cdots + a_0 y = f(x)\), with constant \(a_i\).</text_text>
        </textCard>
        <showcaseCard>
          <title>Homogeneous Equations</title>
          <text>When \(f(x)=0\), solve \(a_n r^n + \cdots + a_0 = 0\).</text>
        </showcaseCard>
        <showcaseCard>
          <title>Distinct / Repeated / Complex Roots</title>
          <text>Distinct: \(y_h=\sum C_i e^{r_i x}\). Repeated \(r\) (mult. \(k\)): \(e^{rx},\ldots,x^{k-1}e^{rx}\). Complex: \(e^{\alpha x}\cos(\beta x),\ e^{\alpha x}\sin(\beta x)\).</text>
        </showcaseCard>
        <mistakesCard>
          <title>Weak Spots</title>

          <mistakesCardItem type="normal">
            <title>Vector Spaces</title>
            <text>61% Mastery</text>
            <caption>5 Mistakes</caption>
          </mistakesCardItem>
        </mistakesCard>
